notes: «نحو حديث محمد بن ربيعة ولم يرفعه» names another transmitter (محمد بن ربيعة) and a non-raised version: the Tirmidhi's commentary line about the Aisha chain is a variant group, never a route (rule 4)
«ورواه وكيع ... نحوه» repeats the first group's names, so it adds no route; «غير واحد من أصحاب النبي» names no one and reports similar sayings, so it is left out
Commentary about the narrators' reliability («ضعيف», «أثبت») is left out
